shared_elements: standing human figure in low relief
glyph blocks arranged in vertical columns
subsidiary smaller figure(s) at lower register
justification: Both surfaces show a large frontal/standing elaborately costumed human figure in shallow relief accompanied by columns of square glyph-like blocks and smaller subordinate figures in a lower register, with the same convention of dense scrollwork, beaded/panelled costume detail and a held vertical implement — a highly specific shared scheme. The main difference is that A presents a clearly legible full-length figure in profile head with a raised staff and a distinct lower captive/attendant scene, while B is a partial, closer view where the figure and its surroundings are less separable and the glyph columns dominate one side.
